corrections.text: The article attributes the quote 'looking for BAD' to Newsweek. That phrase does not appear in the Newsweek source; it is Nextgov/FCW's reporting, which quotes Trump's Truth Social post as saying his administration 'will also be looking for BAD.' The quoted words are accurate; the citation has been corrected to Nextgov/FCW.

The article states 'the White House declined to comment.' The cited source, Nextgov/FCW, reports that 'the White House did not respond to a request for comment about the role of the AI Force or its primary mission' -- meaning the White House did not reply, not that it was asked and actively refused to comment.
